name: WaterMainBreakResponseLog
tagline: From the first call to the lifted boil notice – every water main break in one plug-and-play Power Platform app.
description: Complete water main break response app for water utilities: priority guidance from customers, critical customers, main size and traffic; crew dispatch and arrival; isolation valves (closed / failed) and customers off supply; repair and restoration with recharge checks; precautionary boil water notices with bacteriological sampling and lifting rules; reinstatement and close-out; response targets, long interruptions, customer minutes lost and repeat-break renewal candidates. Canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: P1 / P2 / P3 priority suggestion with reasons for lower priorities
Attend and restore targets per priority with overdue flags
Isolation valve tracking with failed-valve alerts
Customers off supply, long interruptions and customer minutes lost
Boil water notices with sample progress and lifting rules
Customer notice texts and crew briefs for flows
Repeat-break renewal candidates by street, material and age
Bulk close / assign with rule checks, undo
Role-based actions: control room, field crew, water quality, supervisor, viewer
Demo mode, phone layout with bottom navigation, keyboard and ARIA
controlType: standard (2 controls: WaterMainBreakResponseLog data-set + WaterMainBreakResponseLogPortal field)
